title: SimpleLocation
description: Simplified position data for metro vehicles. Published upon receipt of a position message from the train, regardless of whether the message is received through CBTC or CMCS.

eventTimestamp.description: As specified in the ADT documentation. Reflects the UTC time of the position fix. Millisecond precision is preferred, if available.

messageNumber.description: Sequence number, increased by one for each new message. Used to validate consistency in the data stream.

dataSource.description: The source system that provided the position data. CBTC = Communications-Based Train Control, CMCS = Central Monitoring and Control System.
